Fix six open review findings on PR #523 in the caliper repo with ONE redesign (dependabot branch `dependabot/cargo/oxc-92353111ed`, head 0d140e3a, trail 492). In your worktree: `git fetch origin`, `git switch -c fix-oxc4 origin/dependabot/cargo/oxc-92353111ed`; push with `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/dependabot/cargo/oxc-92353111ed` (normal fast-forward; NEVER force; if refused because dependabot moved the branch, fetch and merge onto the new head, then push). You OWN crates/core/src/extractor/** (component.rs, wrapper.rs, evidence.rs, interface.rs, visit.rs, uses.rs, mod.rs, wrapper_matrix_tests.rs) and crates/core/src/resolver/callee.rs; touch nothing else. Read first: /Users/gabe/.claude/projects/-Users-gabe-Projects-caliper/memory/worker-contract.md, evidence-types-direction.md and diagnose-after-three-findings.md (same dir), AGENTS.md (non-negotiables; 'Assert content, not presence'; 'Allow-lists'), crates/core/AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md (pre-push bar), docs/architecture/extractor-ast-visiting.md, docs/audits/2026-11-24-extractor-decisions.md (`git show origin/docs/review-checklist:docs/audits/2026-11-24-extractor-decisions.md`, hits 8 and 'Model and architecture changes' M8), and `gh pr view 523`. Rules: signed commit(s) with trailer `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/REDACTED`; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` first; machine shared (`uptime`; one cargo process at a time; scratch under /tmp/claude-501/); update the PR body FILE /tmp/claude-501/pr-oxc.md in place ('Review round 4'; keep what is true) and the changeset `.changeset/wrapped-component-forms.md`; I publish the body and resolve the Entire findings. Final message max 150 words: head SHA, what each finding turned out to be, blockers. Cap 120 tool calls; never ask questions.

WHAT WENT WRONG. Round 2 over-ACCEPTED (peeling through an assertion as if transparent). Round 3 swung to over-REJECTING: an allow-list (`Peeled::keeps_identity`: only `typeof` the same expression, `any`, `unknown`; `names_its_result`: a type reference or a function type returning one) declines every assertion it does not recognise, so forms the BASE (oxc 0.158 main) detected are now silently dropped: a RECALL REGRESSION with no Diagnostic. Unknown must stay unknown (our own rule: 'unknown unless proven'); an assertion may only DECLINE a candidate on AFFIRMATIVE evidence that the call is not a component, never because the extractor cannot read the asserted type. THE SIX FINDINGS (each a form the base detected or a defect; verify each with a failing test first): (1) medium: `type Factory = typeof createButton; export const Button = (createButton as Factory)()` dropped though `createButton` declares a `React.FC<Props>` return type: resolve a local alias that is `typeof` the same callee before treating the assertion as a signature replacement. (2) medium: `(memo as object as typeof memo)((props: Props) => <div />)`: the OUTER `typeof memo` restores the callee's type but `peel` judges the inner cast: the type of `(e as A) as B` is B, so only the OUTERMOST assertion decides the identity. (3) medium: `(React as { forwardRef: typeof React.forwardRef }).forwardRef<Ref, Props>(render)` rejected: the receiver cast preserves the accessed member's exact type; check the accessed member of a structural receiver assertion, not the whole receiver (base peeled the receiver cast in `react_api`, mod.rs ~735). (4) medium, PERFORMANCE/HANG: a callee with several consecutive `as typeof f` assertions makes `peel` recursively re-scan the remaining assertions and again in its outer loop (component.rs ~210-215): exponential time on ordinary calls reached via visit.rs ~642-644 and uses.rs ~199-200; compute the identity in ONE pass. (5) low: a non-exported JSX helper whose only use is `(Helper as (props: Props) => unknown)(props)` is no longer counted as a call (the visitor still counts the reference), so it survives the call-only filter (uses.rs ~225-230) and appears in output with unexported components: count calls through the underlying identifier independently of whether the asserted signature supplies rendering evidence. (6) medium: `export const Button = (memo as { (render: React.FC<Props>): React.FC<Props> })((props: Props) => <div />)` detected at base, now omitted: the allow-list rejects a callable object type despite its explicit component return: inspect the return types of the call signatures in a type literal. DESIGN (do this, not six patches): replace the boolean identity predicate with a THREE-VALUED evidence about an asserted callee: `Component`/`Renders` (asserted signature affirmatively returns a React component/element type or the callee's own return), `NotRenderable` (asserted signature affirmatively returns a non-renderable type: a primitive keyword, `object`, `void`, an object literal type without call signatures that is no component, `unknown[]` etc.; this is what finding B of round 2 needed: `(Object as (value: object) => object)(props)` stays declined), `Unknown` (alias or `typeof` of another expression, an unresolvable reference, a callable object type whose returns cannot be read, anything else). The rules: only the OUTERMOST assertion decides; `Unknown` keeps the base behaviour (the candidate is detected by name/binding as before) and records a SkippedCandidate-style note or a Diagnostic only where the code already emits one for ambiguous candidates (no new noise on valid code); `NotRenderable` declines; declaration attachment (round 3 finding C: `(wrap as <T>(render: React.FC<T>) => React.FC<T>)<Props>(cb)` must not attach `wrap`'s original declaration when the cast hides fields) stays conservative: attach the original declaration only when the evidence is identity (outermost `typeof` the same callee or alias to it, `any`, `unknown`); otherwise do not attach and let the detected callback props stand (the component is STILL detected). Keep ONE exhaustive match deciding what a wrapper is; compute the whole peel (type arguments, outermost assertion, evidence) in ONE linear pass and pass the `Peeled` down instead of re-peeling per consumer where practical. TESTS: (a) a failing-first test per finding with the exact sources above, asserting exact output; (b) the missing class of test, a NO-RECALL-REGRESSION DIFFERENTIAL: build the extractor from origin/main (oxc 0.158) as an oracle in a scratch dir (or pin its outputs as a table generated from main and checked in as expected values with a comment on how they were produced) and, over the matrix of detection forms crossed with a broad set of assertion types (typeof same/other/alias, any, unknown, object, a callable object type, function types returning FC/ReactElement/ReactNode/string/object/void/unknown, nested casts in both orders, receiver casts, generic function types, `satisfies`, `!`), assert: every form the base detected is still detected UNLESS its row says `NotRenderable` with the evidence named; (c) a linear-time test for a chain of 30 `as typeof f` (count steps with a cfg(test) counter, not wall time) and for 2000-deep nested parentheses/assertions without stack overflow; (d) mutation-prove the three-valued rules. VERIFY: output byte-identical (JSON parsed, `stats` dropped) vs a build of origin/main (oxc 0.158) on /Users/gabe/.cache/caliper/corpora/repos/{mantine/packages/@mantine/core/src,chakra-ui/packages/react/src,shadcn-ui/apps/v4,ant-design/components,react-spectrum/packages}; drop runs whose diagnostics hold a SEMANTIC_BACKEND entry with severity other than info (check code and severity, never message text). Gates by exit code: `just lint doc-check machete typos`, `cargo nextest run --workspace --no-fail-fast` (pty/watch tests need the sandbox off; snapshots in crates/core/tests/snapshots unchanged unless the diff is the intended fix: say so), `just test-checker-lane` (outside the sandbox, no CARGO_TARGET_DIR).

# Audit: name-, peel- and shape-based decisions in the extractor and resolver Read-only audit of `origin/main` at `git fetch` time (oxc 0.158.0). Scope: `crates/core/src/extractor/**`, `resolver/**`, `import_map.rs`, `known.rs`, `react_types.rs`, `types/ambient.rs`. Line numbers are `origin/main`. **Reproduced** marks hits run through the CLI: `caliper-docgen extract -s --json --quiet --no-cache --no-checker --html-attributes none`. The binary was built in worktree `agent-aa40b3efb28981791` (branch `fix-519c`), whose `crates/core/src/extractor`, `resolver/callee.rs` and `resolver/mod.rs` have no diff from `origin/main`. The fixtures are in `/tmp/claude-501/repro/src/{a,b,config,lib}.tsx`. Everything else was found by reading the source; none of it was run under the checker. ADR 0026 makes the checker the type authority, but component _detection_ is still the extractor's, so every wrong component below is published whichever backend runs. Classes: (a) a decision made by name or spelling, (b) several predicates answering one question, (c) a catch-all arm that makes a decision, (d) peeling wrappers, (e) dependence on oxc node shapes. Severity: **W** = produces a wrong component, prop or type; **M** = only misses one; **S** = style or latent. ## Top 10 by severity 1. **(a) The "renders" evidence is mostly names.** `extractor/evidence.rs` (W, reproduced ×4) - :175, a PascalCase callee counts as a render: `return String(x)`, `Immutable.Map(x)`, `Number(x)`. - :116-122, `is_children` accepts any `.children`. - :21/:26-31, the receiver is ignored for every factory except `h`, so `document.createElement` counts. - :17/:96, the bare name `Element` (the DOM global) counts as React's element type when unbound. - :112/:219, any `useX(…)` call makes the function render. ```tsx export const FormatId = (p: IdProps) => String(p.id) // component (typedFunctionExpression) export const GetChildren = (n: TreeNode) => n.children // component export const MakeDiv = (p: Opts) => document.createElement(p.tag) // component export function GetNode(p: Sel): Element { return document.querySelector(p.sel)! } // component ``` Fix: - Drop the PascalCase-call rule, or require the callee to be a binding the file maps as a component (`component_mappings` / `element_helpers`). - Accept `children` only as `props.children` or a destructured `children` of the first parameter: `body_facts` already binds the props symbol. - Make `is_element_factory_name` require React's or Preact's binding for every name, not only `h`. - Remove the bare `Element`: `JSX.Element` is matched through `leftmost_and_rightmost`. - Count a hook call only when there is no return-type evidence against it, or drop it. 2. **(a/c) `is_component_wrapper_call` is a list of name conventions.** `extractor/component.rs:934-948` (W, reproduced) - `callee.contains("Component")`, `lower.contains("forwardref")`, `with[A-Z]…` and `observer` all count as wrappers. - `Expression::CallExpression(_) => return true` accepts every curried call. - Through `is_component_alias_call` (:915) this decides alias identity in `alias_shape` (:739), `component_wrapped_by` (uses.rs:84), `record_call` (uses.rs:203) and wrapper evidence (wrapper.rs:109). ```tsx export function Card(p: CardProps) { return
} declare function getComponentName(c: unknown): string export const CardName = getComponentName(Card) // published as a component with Card's props export const Keyed = keyFor('x')(Card) // curried: also an alias of Card ``` Fix: decide by binding. React's `memo`/`forwardRef` go through `react_api`. Anything else is only a candidate (emit `SkippedCandidate`, or publish only when the checker confirms that the call's return type is a component). At minimum remove `contains("Component")` and the curried `=> true`. 3. **(a) Any function type a factory returns is treated as a component.** `resolver/callee.rs:338-340` (W, reproduced) - `CollectedType::Function { params, .. }` is read as a component whose props are `params[0]`, and the return type is never checked. - `resolver/mod.rs:1053` ("a call to a function whose result is no component is no component") depends on that check, so nothing stops a non-component. ```tsx function makeFormatter(): (value: T) => string { return (v) => String(v) } export const Format = makeFormatter() // component "Format" (factoryResult) with prop `amount` ``` Fix: accept `Function` only when `return_type` is React's element or node type, resolved by binding. Otherwise return `None`. 4. **(b) Sibling paths skip the render evidence.** (W, reproduced ×2) - `try_typed_function_expression`, `mapping_from_typed_function` and `visit_function` all call `evidence::renders`. - `record_inline_sub_component` (`extractor/interface.rs:488-532`, used by `Object.assign` :443 and `Root.X = fn` :483) does not. - Neither does `try_anonymous_default_export_component` (`component.rs:557-598`). ```tsx function Api() { return null } export const Client = Object.assign(Api, { Format: (v: ApiProps) => v.url.toUpperCase() }) // "Format" component // config.tsx export default function (opts: Options) { return { ...opts, ready: true } } // "Config" component ``` Fix: call `renders(&FunctionShape::…)` in both, and record the reason as a skip. Long term, see M2. 5. **(a) A synthesized props name can collide with one the source declares.** `extractor/component.rs:864-877` (W, reproduced) - `push_imported_alias` names the props type `"ComponentProps"`, which resolves through normal scoped lookup. - A file that declares its own `ComponentProps` gives every imported-member alias those props. ```tsx import * as Lib from './lib' // Lib.Thing has props { real: number } type ComponentProps = { local: boolean } export const Alias = Lib.Thing // output: Alias { local: boolean } ``` Fix: use a name no source can write, as `record_declared_value_type` already does with `"typeof X"`. Better, make it a `TypeName::Synthesized` variant (M6). 6. **(d) An `as` assertion is read as `as const`, or as transparent, for literal types.** (W, reproduced ×2) - `extractor/interface.rs:19-27` (`as_const_literal`) accepts any `TSAsExpression` or `TSTypeAssertion` as `as const`. It feeds `try_collect_const_enum` and `try_collect_const_array`. - `extractor/values.rs:16-28` (`peel`) treats `as T` and `x` as transparent ("none of them changes which literal it is"). That is true of the value, but the type is what gets recorded. ```ts export const SIZES = ['sm', 'md'] as string[] // (typeof SIZES)[number] → "sm" | "md" (should be string) export const DEFAULT_SIZE = 'sm' as string // typeof DEFAULT_SIZE → "sm" (should be string) ``` Fix: recognize `as const` explicitly (a `TSTypeReference` whose name is `const`). For any other `as T` or `x`, record the asserted type, or nothing. `satisfies`, `!` and parentheses stay transparent. 7. **(a/b) `Omit`/`Pick`/`Partial`/`Required`/`Readonly` are classified by spelling and never re-checked.** (W, reproduced) - `extractor/alias.rs:18-160` classifies these into `CollectedTypeAlias::{Omit,Pick,Partial,Required}` by spelling. - `resolver/alias.rs:38ff` applies them without `may_be_ts_lib_type`. - The `extends` path does check the binding (`chain.rs:201,232`, `alias.rs:291`), so the two sibling paths disagree. ```ts type Partial = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] | null }; // the project's own type NullableBase = Partial; export function Nullable(p: NullableBase) { return
; } // output: a: string (optional), `| null` lost ``` Fix: in the resolver, use the classified variant only when `may_be_ts_lib_type(name)` holds. Otherwise resolve as `Passthrough` of the written `Named`. Simpler still: the extractor records only `Named` and the resolver classifies after binding (ADR 0025, resolver owns scoping). 8. **(d) Finding 3's class is still open at several callee and export sites.** (W, by reading) `peel_expr` (`component.rs:20-31`) treats `as` as transparent, and these sites use it on a callee or export: - `try_record_factory_call` (`wrapper.rs:491`) takes the callee through a cast: `(makeX as unknown as OtherFactory)

()` uses `makeX`'s recorded result. - `react_api` (`mod.rs:735,744`): `(memo as unknown as Custom)(X)` is read as React's memo. - `is_forward_ref_call` (:886) and `is_component_wrapper_call` (:936). - `pending_function_aliases` (`visit.rs:355-358`) copies `f`'s result to `const g = f as G`. - The default export (`visit.rs:660`, `:714-720` via `component_wrapped_by`, `reexports.rs:83`): `export default Button as unknown as FC` exports `Button` with Button's props. The assertion is dropped with no diagnostic. - Only `asserted.rs` handles this, for one shape: a default export asserted to a function type, with a single `as`. Fix: one peel that returns `Asserted(type)` (M8). Callee consumers decline or use the asserted type. Export consumers apply the asserted type the way `asserted.rs` does, for every shape. 9. **(a) An unbound name is taken as React's, and local declarations are ignored.** (W, by reading) - `react_api` (`extractor/mod.rs:733-759`), `react_type_export` (:765-785) and `may_be_react` (:787-793) look only at imports. - So `const memo = (f) => f`, `function forwardRef(…)` or `type FC

= (p: P) => string` declared in the file all count as React's. - `resolver/callee.rs:22-28,342-363` (`is_component_type`) strips `React.` with no binding check at all, and checks before `lookup_interface`, so a local `interface ExoticComponent` is not found first. - `react_types.rs:306-372` lists DOM globals (`MouseEvent`, `KeyboardEvent`, `FocusEvent`, …) as React builtins, and `may_be_react_builtin` gives them React's meaning when unbound. ```tsx type FC
